Commentary.Commentary: We've got news here! Kane Williamson has asked the home side to have a go in the final session. The Kiwis have done their job with the bat and it would be interesting to see how their bowlers show their skills on a flat deck. You can sit back and enjoy the game.
... Day 2, Session 3 ...

The Zimbabweans have been made to toil hard on the field as none of their bowlers could scalp a wicket in this session. But one thing they will be happy about is the bang on overrate. Other than that, talking about a toothless bowling attack won't make much sense here. How much more will the Kiwis feel is enough for this African side? To know, join us in a bit for the final session.

This session - 33 Overs, 146 Runs, 0 Wickets! New Zealand have already posted a mammoth total on the board and still are showing no signs of declaration. Ross Taylor and BJ Watling seem to have a nice bonding as even in the first Test they stringed a big stand and have replicated the same once again. The former scored his 15th Test ton and in the process got a huge reprieve when he was batting on 91 by debutant Peter Moor.  His counter-part is on the verge of getting to his own.
Once again Tiripano drfiting on to Taylor's pads, and he loves it there, comfortably flicks it down to fine leg for a single. AND THAT'S TEA ON DAY 2!
FOUR! Too full and too straight and Donald pays the price. Just going down leg, Taylor just helps it along its way. Goes past the keeper and away to the boundary rope.
Full delivery on off, driven to mid off. Will get no run for it.
Fuller on middle and off, it's kept out from deep within the crease.
On middle again, quite straight as well, clipped in front of short mid-wicket.
Full delivery on middle and leg, swinging in, Taylor walks across and works it easily through mid-wicket for two runs.
Ross Taylor whips this towards mid-wicket but is unable to beat the diving fielder there. That brings us to the end of this over.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and drills it to wide long off. Single taken.
Raza floats this one up nicely on middle and leg, BJ wrists this to the right of the bowler. No run taken.
Still on the shorter side and around off, tapped to covers off the back foot.
Drags the length back a bit, it's a bit on the slower side as well, Ross goes back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Raza has a change of angles, comes around the wicket to Taylor, tosses it up and it's clipped towards backward square leg.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
FOUR BYES! Fullish and going way down leg, Watling looks to flick it away but misses and so does Moor. Races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Byes signalled by the umpire.
Angling in and fuller on the stumps, it's flicked down to fine leg. One run added to the scoreboard.
Pitched up once more, around off, a solid front foot defense it presented to keep it out.
Fired in on off, aimed at the base of off stump, pushed in front of covers.
Fuller length delivery on off, played off the front foot.
Floated nicely by Raza, the batsman comes down the track to block it out.
BJ goes for the sweep shot but misses and is rapped on the pads on this full ball.
FOUR! Tossed up around off, Watling makes good use of his feet. Gets to the pitch of the ball, swings his arms and lofts it over mid off to send the ball across the fence. Lovely shot.
On leg, it's clipped off the pads towards backward square leg for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Short and going down leg, pulled away through backward square leg for a single.
SIKANDAR RAZA is on to bowl.
Full outside off, worked away to the point fielder. Dot ball.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Attacking the stumps this time, full on middle and leg, coming in slightly, Ross just about manages to block it out with a straight bat.
FOUR! DISPATCHED! Back of a length on off, Taylor stays back and pulls it through the square leg region and sends it all the way to the boundary line.
Angling in on middle and leg, on a length as well, it's kept out well by the batsman.
Play and a miss! Length delivery outside off, Taylor looks to cut this away hard but fails to get any connection on it.
Fullish from Sean, hit down to long off for a single to end the over.
Outside off, slapped to deep extra cover. One run taken.
Looped up delivery just outside off, RT drives it through the cover region for a single.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, trademark from Taylor. He rocks back and cuts it ever so well through point to pick up a boundary. How often have we seen that from him?
Floated around off, Ross comes down the track and blocks it out.
Loopy and fuller outside off, it's driven to covers for no run.
Aimed at the top of off stump, defended from within the crease.

Full and angling down, hits Watling on the pads as he tries to flick it away.
On a length and outside off, Taylor opens the face of the bat and dabs it towards point for a run.
Full on the off stump, RT walks across and works it in front of mid-wicket.
Fuller length delivery, coming in sharply, Ross gets behind the line and defends it well.
DONALD TIRIPANO comes back on.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. Two runs added to the total.
Outside off, played to point for nothing.
Shortish outside off, it's punched to covers but can't beat the diving fielder there.
Floated around off, driven to covers for no run.
Nice flight there from Sean, seducing Watling into the drive. There's some dip as well and the ball beats the outside edge.
Loopy and fullish outside off, pushed to covers by Taylor for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
An off cutter outside off, hit to point for no run.

FOUR! Good reaction and well played. High full toss around off, Watling leans behind and plays a stylish upper cut. Sends it aerially towards the third man fence for a boundary. No ball called for the height.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
On a length and angled across Watling, he opens the face of the bat and dabs it to backward point.
Good length ball outside off, nicely punched off the back foot to covers.
Back of a length outside off, cut away square on the off side for a single.
Floats it up on the stumps, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Fullish on off, hit down to mid off. No run taken.
15th Test century for Ross Taylor!
The batsman drives this through the covers. The batsmen have run through for a single. He completes his ton with that and it's been an excellent knock so far.
Outside off, hit to deep cover for one.

That was really close! Excellently tossed up just outside off, Watling prods forward to block it out but the ball just whizzes past the outside edge. There are loud appeals but the umpire turns it down. Good decision.
Looped up on middle and leg, driven down to long on for a single.
Full outside off, worked to covers for a single.
FOUR! And he makes them pay now. Just shows you can't drop a player of his quality. Back of a length on middle and off, Taylor rocks back in a jiffy and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.

DROPPED! Chance goes begging. He should have taken that really. Length ball angled across, well outside off, Taylor stays back and looks to cut it away. Gets an edge behind and Moor drops it. He gets low to take it but spills it. It goes behind him as two runs are taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Back of a length delivery outside off, it's chopped hard but to the man at point.
Fuller outside off, Ross drives it to covers.

Floats this one up outside off, Taylor gets an edge to point as he goes for the drive.

Floated up on middle and off, driven back to the bowler.

Driven through covers by the Kiwi keeper to keep strike.
Drilled! Fuller length delivery served outside off, Taylor leans into it and drills it through covers. Won't get a boundary but will get three runs to his tally.
Good length delivery on off, punched off the back foot towards covers for a single.
Short and outside off again, Watling looks to cut but gets a bottom edge towards the off side.
Touch short and outside off, Taylor punches it through covers for a single.
On a length and outside off, Taylor shoulders his arms to that one.
Loopy ball around leg, Watling looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up around off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Flatter ball outside off, punched towards long on for an easy single.
Loopy ball around leg, driven past mid on for one.
Full and around off, pushed back to Sean.

Tad short and outside off, Taylor slaps it through sweeper cover for a single.
Driven through covers for a single.
full on middle, driven back to the bowler.
Taylor has played it to the point region. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, driven towards covers.
Wide! Full and wide outside off, left alone.
Fuller length delivery on off, driven towards covers.
PRINCE MASVAURE into the attack!
Full and around middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Full and around off, Taylor defends it off the front foot gently.
Bowls it around off, Watling punches it down to long on for a single.
Driven past the man at mid off for a single.
Full on the stumps, bunted back to the bowler.
Tossed up around middle and off, defended off the front foot.
Darted on middle, clipped through the leg side for a single.
Flighted ball around off, Watling dabs it towards backward point for a single.
BJ has punched the ball off the back foot.
Around middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket. Taylor wanted a single but won't get there.
Short on middle, Watling pulls it in front of square where Ervine makes a diving stop.
Loopy ball around off, guided towards third man for one.
Worked away on the square on the leg side for a single.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Pushed through covers for a single.
Landed outside off, Taylor guides it towards third man.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, Watling comes down the track and drives it towards long on for a single.
Driven through mid off for a single.

FOUR! Misfield! Loopy delivery around off, BJ comes down the track, gets to the pitch and drives it towards covers. Tiripano makes a mess out of it as the ball goes off his hands towards the fence. 500 up for NZ!
On middle and leg, worked towards the leg side.
12th Test fifty for BJ Watling!

FOUR! What a way to bring up the 50! These two are carrying their form from the first Test. Loopy ball around off, Watling comes down the track and absolutely drills it through covers for a boundary. Raises the bat and gets a pat on the back by his partner.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, Watling eases it down to long on for a single.
Fligted ball around middle, driven back to the bowler.
Comes down the track and plays it back to the bowler.
On middle and off, Ross presses forward and defends it down.
Short and outside off, punched off the back foot through covers for a single.
Flighted ball around off, pushed towards covers.
Tossed up around off, driven towards covers.
Loopy ball around leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single. That brings up the 100-run stand as well.
Loopy ball around off, Taylor gets forward and drives it through covers and some good running between the wickets allows them to come back for the third.
Short on off, punched down to mid on.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and around off, RT defends it off the front foot.
Drags his length back and Watling punches it through extra covers for three runs.
Floated ball around leg, Watling comes forward and nudges it towards short mid-wicket. Taylor comes down the track for a single but is sent back in time.
Tossed up around off, Taylor defends it watchfully.
Flatter on the pads, flicked towards square leg for a single.
Landed outside off, steered towards point for no runs.
Loopy ball around off, pushed towards covers.
FOUR! Bad ball and deserved the treatment! Short and outside off, Watling camps back and punches it through covers for a boundary.
BJ lunges forward and defends it off the front foot.
Flighted ball around off, Ross comes down the track and drives it back to Nyumbu. He then turns back and hurries into the crease before the bowler could even think of throwing it at the stumps.
Full and around off, Taylor presses forward and blocks it down.

Loopy ball around middle, pushed towards the man at mid on.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
Low full toss down the leg side swept towards backward square leg for a single.
The man is asked to protect the third man area now...

Landed outside off, punched towards covers.
Another short ball, this time Taylor cuts it towards point for a single.
FOUR! Cut away sweetly! Short and bowled outside off, Taylor won't miss out on this one as he gets back in a jiffy and cuts it behind point for a boundary.
SEAN WILLIAMS into the attack!
Darted on middle, clipped towards short mid-wicket.
Knocked down to long on for a single.
Loopy delivery around leg, Watling flicks it hard and it hits Ervine on its way toward square leg for one.
Punched off the back foot towards covers for a single.

On middle and leg, driven down to long on for a single.
Drags his length back this time and Taylor cuts it late behind point. Picks up three runs.
Loopy ball around off, Taylor looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards the off side.
The batsman plays a sweep shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
BJ gets into the position early and looks to play the reverse sweep but misses.
Flighted ball around off, Watling comes down the track and pushes it towards covers.
Drops it short on middle, pulled towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off, coming in with the angle. Cramps Watling for room who goes for the cut shot and gets an inside edge just over the timber.
Full and around off, defended gently.
BJ has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

On middle and off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Loopy ball around leg, whipped through mid-wicket and wanted two immediately and gets it in the end with ease.
On middle and off, defended off the front foot watchfully.
Around middle and leg, it's well defended off the front foot by RT.
On middle, bunted towards mid on for a single to keep strike.
On middle and leg, nudged toward square leg for a single.
Shortish outside off, cut straight to point.
Pushed towards covers for no runs.
Bye! Loopy ball around middle and leg, Taylor looks to flick but misses and Moor was covered by the batsman and as a result even he failed to collect it. A bye is conceded.
On middle and off, defended off the front foot.
FOUR! Reverse swept! Loopy ball around middle and off, Watling gets down on one knee and reverse sweeps it through cover-point for a boundary.
Landed around off, BJ prods forward only to defend it down.

Outside off, defended by pressing forward.

BJ has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Short and outside off, punched off the back foot gently.

Loopy ball around off, played off the front foot.
On middle and leg, defended off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter on leg, turning in. Taylor looks to pull but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Full and around middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball down the leg side, swept towards short fine leg.
Tossed up around leg, driven down to long on for a single.
50-run stand between Taylor and Watling!
FOUR! Swept away fine! Loopy ball around middle and leg, Watling gets down on one knee and sweeps it off the meat of the bat towards square leg for a boundary.
Full and around middle, Taylor looks to flick but it goes off the leading edge towards long off for a single.
Taylor defends it off the front foot gently.
Full and around middle and leg, swept towards backward square leg for a single.
Loopy ball around leg, tucked towards square leg.
Comes around around the wicket and bowls a loopy ball around middle, flicked towards short mid-wicket.

Welcome back for the afternoon session, folks! So, how long will the kiwis bat? Surely bat once but bat big will be the moto. For now, ROSS TAYLOR AND BJ WATLING will continue from where they left off. JOHN NYUMBU will start off with the bowling proceedings. Let's start...
... Day 2, Session 2 ...

The visitors look poised to put up a huge total on the board, and it's no surprise they'd do just that. But the real question is, when will Kane Williamson decide that he's seen enough and declare? We'll find that out soon. Join us for the second session in a short while.

On a flat track which doesn't have much to offer, Zimbabwe were decent, all things considered. But you'd think they ought to do a little more. They did manage to get two wickets but couldn't stop the runs leaking. Chinouya and Cremer bagged one wicket each and were alright in their spells. The rest couldn't inflict any damage or keep the pressure on for others to benefit from.

The first which has once again seen New Zealand dominate. 27.1 overs, 107 runs, 2 wickets - And it's gone by rather quickly. Kane Williamson and Ross Taylor started things off and played sensibly well, seeing out the good balls and dispatching the loose ones. The Kiwi skipper went on to complete his ton while the latter is still unbeaten and has completed his fifty. He is partnered by BJ Watling and the pair are playing quite solidly. Henry Nicholls once again failed to impress, started off well but then got out soon enough.
Tossed up around middle, Taylor gets behind the line and answers it with a straight bat. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 2!
Three Byes! Down the leg side, Watling gets down to sweep but misses and so does Peter Moor. The fielder gives it a chase abut the pair take three by then.
Full and around off, blocked nicely.
Gives it a bit more air this time, Watling comes down the track to flick but isn't quite pitch to the ball. Gets a safe leading edge back to Cremer.
Loopy ball around off, Watling comes forward and defends again.
Loopy ball around middle, defended off the front foot firmly.
Loopy ball around off, driven through covers.
Watling camps back and punches it through covers for a single.
25th Test fifty for Ross Taylor!
Ross the Boss! Loopy ball around middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single. Back-to-back fifties for him in this series.
Watling gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards the leg side for a single.
Taylor comes down the track and drives it through covers for another three runs.
Loopy ball around off, defended off the front foot.
Short and around off, Taylor waits for the ball to come and cuts it late through point. Some good running between the wickets allow them to take three.
Outside off, played with an opened face bat towards third man for a couple.
Ouch! That must have hurt! Drops it short on middle, Taylor camps back and pulls it firmly. The short leg fielder was ducking to evade it and gets hit on the shin-pads.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
Loopy ball around off, driven through covers for a single.
Loopy and full on the stumps, driven to the covers for a single.
Punched off the back foot towards covers.
Flatter one around middle, punched back to the bowler.
Full and around off, BJ lunges forward and defends it gently.
Tossed up around middle, defended back to the bowler.
Loopy ball around middle and off, Watling defends it off the front foot.
Full and around middle, defended off the front foot.
Drags the length back as it is pitched outside off, the batsman goes back and hits it to sweeper cover for a single. He'll retain strike.
Flighted nicely on middle and off, it's bunted back in the direction of the bowler.
BJ defends it off the front foot presenting the full face of the bat.

Much, much better from the Zimbabwean skipper. Tosses up a lovely leg spinner around off, teasing the batsman to come forward. Watling does so and is beaten comprehensively by the turn. Just beats the outside edge as Moor collects it well behind the stumps.

FOUR! Rare bad ball from Cremer and it's punished. Flatter and shorter on the stumps, Watling has all the time in the world to get back and pull it through the mid-wicket region. Sends the ball all the way to the fence and gets a boundary to his name.
This is shorter in length as well, goes back and punches it straight to short cover.
Flatter and shorter around off, a back foot punch to cover to end the over.
Swept down to fine leg for an easy single by BJ. Does it quite comfortably too.
John with some nice flight on this, tosses it up on off, it's dead-batted to the off side.
Tossed up on off, Watling leans across, kneels down and sweeps it fine down the leg side for a brace. Good placement, there.
Turning in on middle and off, Taylor goes back and plays this with the spin. Turns it to backward square leg and picks up a single.
Nyumbu starts off with a nice flighted delivery around off, an off spinner, Taylor comes ahead and blocks it out with a nice straight bat.
JOHN NYUMBU is introduced into the bowling attack for the first time today.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Another solid front foot defense to keep this tossed up delivery out.
Flights it on off stump, Watling presses forward and buries it into the ground. Tight defense from the wicketkeeper batsman.
Darted just outside off, a straighter one, BJ prods forward to keep it out.
John Nyumbu is seen struggling with his ankle. He went to stop the ball at covers but couldn't move an inch. He is down on the field and is asking for some attention from the physio.
Loopy and pitched full outside off, Taylor drives it past Nyumbu at covers. He runs to his left and dives to stop it but stops and is down as he seems to have pulled something. A single is completed.
Tossed up nicely outside off, Ross drives it square on the off side towards point.
On a good length and outside off, no shot offered to this one.
Full and outside off, driven through covers for a single.

FOUR! BAM! He was in complete control as he played that. And he's so strong in that area. Length ball around off, the ball keeps slightly low but Taylor doesn't care. He rocks back and pulls this powerfully through mid-wicket to pick up a boundary. Top shot!
Length ball on off, Taylor hits this to the man at mid off.
Fullish delivery on middle and off, it's pushed down to mid on. Into the fielder's hands as no run is taken.
FOUR! Easy as they come! Straying on the pads, Ross just has to help this fine down the leg side to send it all the way to the boundary line.
Sliding in on leg, BJ gets down to sweep it away but gets it off the glove. The slip fielder runs to collect the ball and restricts the batsmen to a couple.
Floated on off, Watling with a tight defensive shot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Drifting on the stumps, it's worked to the leg side. Will get nothing for it.
Graeme provides some nice flight on this one, bowls it around off, a solid front foot defense is presented on this.
Tossed up on middle stump, Taylor skips out to this one and eases it down to long off for one run.
Good length ball on off, a front foot defense by BJ Watling to end a solid over from Chibhabha.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full on middle and off, Ross Taylor drives it straight to the man at mid on. Quite unfortunate for him.
Full in length once again and angling in to Taylor, he turns it towards the mid-wicket region.
Chamu pitches it up around off, driven to covers but it's straight to the fielder.
Back of a good length around off, Ross mistimes his punch to mid on. No run taken.
Slider around off, which skids on after pitching, Watling is caught his crease as he tries to play at this. Gets an inside edge onto his boot as the ball falls into the track.
Taylor drives this fuller ball down towards mid off for a run.
Cremer floats this one up nicely, on off stump, it's gently turned to the on side for nothing.
Shortish and outside off, BJ cuts it through cover-point for one run.
Drags the length back ever so slightly, Watling gets behind the line and blocks it out well.
Floated around off, driven down to long off for a single.
Watling with a comfortable leave as he sees the ball go outside his off stump.
Pitched just around off, BJ stays back and bunts it to covers.
FOUR! Shot. Back of a length delivery outside off, Watling quickly gets back and slices this away hard. It's in the air and the ball races away to the third man fence for a boundary.
Length ball in the corridor outside off, withdraws his bat to let it go past him.
On a length, outside off, Watling stays back and looks to cut it away but ends up getting a bottom edge on it.
Shortish delivery pitched outside off, Taylor goes back and punches it square on the off side for a single.
CHAMU CHIBHABHA is brought into the bowling attack.
Going down leg, Watling looks to flick this away but misses as the keeper shuffles across to collect it.
BJ WATLING is the next batsman in.

OUT! THE BOWLING CHANGE DOES THE TRICK! And it's the skipper with the breakthrough. He admitted yesterday that he was quite poor in the final session and today, he redeems himself. Tosses this up nicely on middle, it's a straighter one as the ball holds its line after pitching. Nicholls kneels down to sweep this away but misses his shot and is rapped on the front pad. Cremer and Moor roar for an lbw appeal and the umpire raises his finger. The southpaw is gone and he's failed here yet again.
FOUR! Cremer floats this up outside off, almost a full toss really, Nicholls stands his ground and swings his bat hard at this. Drives it crisply through the covers to pick up a boundary.
Loops this up well around off, Henry presses forward and dead-bats it into the track.
Loopy leg spinner around off, slightly shorter in length, Ross goes back and punches it to mid off for a single.
Cremer starts off with a nicely tossed up delivery on the foot, Taylor clears his front leg and works it to the on side.
GRAEME CREMER comes into the attack.
Temps Henry Nicholls with another one outside off, touch fuller in length, he's careful this time and makes a watchful leave.
Angled across the batsman, an easy leave made. No need to even play at that.
Tighter line from Donald here, keeps it quite close to the off stump. Nicholls raises his bat to let it be as the ball just goes past the off stump. Good shape on that from Tiripano as well.
Back of a length outside off, the southpaw stands tall and defends it down into the ground.
Good length delivery outside off, it's well away from Henry who has no trouble leaving that one alone.
Touch short and on off, it's bunted back to Tiripano.
Full and aimed at the stumps, driven down towards mid on to end the over.

JUST FALLS SHORT! A bit of excitement for the bowlers. Nicholls falls prety to it as he is tempted to come forward and drive. It's a fuller length delivery outside off and there's a big nick on that. It flies towards gully where the ball falls just short of Craig Ervine who dives low to this left. It goes off his hands as the batsmen take a single. Nicholls once again looking a little shaky here.
Well outside off, and on a length too, well left by the left-hander.
Fuller in length and angled across, outside off and wanting to get Nicholls to drive, he isn't interested in it though and shoulders his arms to this one.
Slightly fuller in length and pitched outside off, Ross slightly walks across, stays deep in his crease and crunches this to deep cover for a comfortable single.
Leg bye! Length ball aimed at the hips, Henry looks to flick this away but the ball goes off the thigh pad. A leg bye is taken as the ball rolls to the on side.
Drinks break!
Strays on the pads, Taylor gets across and flicks it through square leg. Raza from fine leg comes across to his left and does well to save some runs for his team. A double taken.
Fuller length delivery outside off, pushed towards the off side.
Good length ball on off, defended towards the man at mid on.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Fuller length delivery on middle, worked towards short mid-wicket.

Good length delivery on off, Ross looks to flick but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Short and outside off, Taylor looks to cut but gets a safe outside edge towards Ervine at gully.
Fuller length delivery outside off, Taylor prods forward and defends it down.
Outside off, defended back to the bowler.
Fuller on the pads, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
On a length and outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Fuller length delivery on off, driven hard but straight to covers.
In the channel outside off, Henry lifts his bat and lets it go through.
Fuller on off, HN offers a solid front foot defense.

FOUR! Edged away! Fuller length delivery outside off, actually wide outside off. Nicholls prods forward to drive but ends up getting a thick outside edge which flies past a diving Ervine at gully for a boundary towards third man.
Outside off, left alone.
On a length and around middle, defended nicely.

New Zealand are in a commanding position at the day's end and are primed to put on a really big score, most likely with the intention of not batting again in this match. The hosts tried everything to get back in the game but lacked the innovation and an alternate game plan to come up with a breakthrough when it was needed most. They were toiled with and taken to the cleaners at will by the Kiwi batsmen. Donald Tiripano and Sean Williams, who is a part-time bowler at best, were the ones to take wickets today, 1 apiece exactly.

123 runs, 30.5 overs and 1 wicket, which has come off the last ball of the day - This is what has happened in a nutshell. New Zealand once again dominated another session, where they left the Zimbabwean bowlers dumbfounded when faced with the challenge of scalping wickets. Latham and Williamson stitched a massive partnership of 160 runs with the former completing another ton and the Kiwi skipper on the verge on making his ton, and almost saw the day off. The southpaw opener was caught and bowled on the very last ball of the day by Sean Williams.

Welcome back for the post-Lunch session of this second Test. New Zealand are in prime control and will look to build on their good start. Zimbabwe desperately need a wicket, that too soon, and they'll look to attack from the word go. Guptill and Latham will continue with the bat as Cremer takes the ball first up.
... DAY 1, SESSION 2 ...

Zimbabwe on the other hand, have been listless and devoid of any fight. They have been inconsistent with their lines and lengths and have failed to create any kind of pressure on the Kiwi openers. They need to sit down in this break and come up with a different gameplan, otherwise they risk the chance of New Zealand running away with it here. Join us for the second session which will come up in a short while.

Guptill and Latham have looked at ease throughout the entire session and not once did it look like any of them would falter. Martin Guptill and Tom Latham are the two openers. Martin Guptill is at the crease. Donald Tiripano is with the ball. Here we go...
Team Changes - New Zealand unchanged. Tino Mawoyo, Peter Moor and John Nyumbu are the three changes for Zimbabwe.
Pitch report - The pitch has a bit of grass. It will help the seamers for some swing and later in the game, the spin should be handy. The captains will like to bat first and bat long.
Toss - New Zealand win the toss and elect to bat first.

From the hosts point of view, they really have to put up a fight to level this 2-match Test series. The injury worry of their main player Hamilton Masakadza will make it more difficult for them. The home side will surely like to find their feet and show up some resistance and fight to play this high-flying Kiwi side with bat and ball. Do join us in a bit for the toss and other updates.

Hello and a warm welcome for the 2nd Test between Zimbabwe and New Zealand at Queens Sports Club, Bulawayo. The visiting side has won the first Test match comprehensively by 117 runs and an innings. The Kiwis have played their hearts out in both the departments. They had three centurions and a brilliant bowling display in the first match.
